# javaabu/bulk-actions

> Fluent bulk actions for Laravel index pages. Define the actions of a listing once (a class extending Javaabu\BulkActions\BulkActions), authorize each with can() (who may run it) and canEach() (which records, through the model's policy) via Laravel's Gate, ask for input with a javaabu/stencil form, and run them on the selected records or on every record matching the listing's filters (javaabu/filters, optional), chunked and queued for large selections with polled progress. The selection and action UI is built on javaabu/forms' table in Blade (<x-bulk-actions::actions>) and @javaabu/forms' Table in Inertia React (BulkActionsTable from @javaabu/bulk-actions). Dhivehi and RTL built in.

Paths are relative to this file. In a project, that's vendor/javaabu/bulk-actions/.

## Rules

- Define a listing's actions in a class that extends `Javaabu\BulkActions\BulkActions`, with `protected ?string $model` and `actions()`. Inline `BulkActions::make([...])` can't be queued.
- Build actions with `Action::make('name')->label(__('…'))->handle(fn (Collection $records) => …)` or `->each(fn (Article $article) => …)`. Use the built-in `DeleteAction`, `RestoreAction` and `ForceDeleteAction` instead of writing your own.
- Authorize with `->can('permission_or_ability', $arguments)` (hides the action and 403s) and `->canEach('update')` (checked per record with the policy; failing records are skipped). Never rely on `visible()`/`hidden()` for security.
- Scope which records may be selected by overriding `newQuery()` (or `->query()`), not inside the handler. Ids outside the query are ignored.
- Ask for input with `->form([stencil fields])`; the handler gets the validated values as `$data`. Don't read `$request` in handlers. Don't name fields `action`, `all`, `filters`, `redirect` or the selection's name.
- Register routes yourself: `Route::bulkActions('articles', ArticleBulkActions::class)` (POST articles/bulk) and `Route::bulkActionRuns()` inside the app's route group; pass `guard` for other guards.
- Blade: put `<x-bulk-actions::actions :actions="$bulk_actions" :paginator="$articles" />` in the `bulk-form` slot of `<x-forms::table model="articles">`, with `:action="$bulk_actions->getUrl()"`. React: pass `ArticleBulkActions::make()->paginator($articles)` as a prop and render `<BulkActionsTable bulkActions={bulkActions}>`.
- For "select all matching", give the class the listing's filters: `$this->filters(ArticleFilters::class)` (javaabu/filters) or a closure `fn (Builder $query, array $filters) => …`, and pass the paginator so the UI knows the total.
- Selections above `bulk-actions.queue_after` (500) are queued: run a queue worker, schedule `model:prune` for `BulkActionRun`, run `php artisan permissions:sync`. Use `->queue(false)` for actions that can't be queued (file uploads).
- Labels, confirmation questions and success messages go through `__()`; add Dhivehi to `lang/dv.json`. Use Thaana in tests of user-facing behaviour.
- Test through the route: `postJson(route('articles.bulk'), ['action' => 'publish', 'articles' => [...]])` and assert on `succeeded`, `skipped`, `failed`.
